class.name: HTMLSelectElement
class.description: [HTMLLabel] draws a dropdown or list box and emits [signal HTMLLabel.select_changed] for user changes. Script assignments update selection silently.

method.name: get_options
method.description: Returns the options as a tree-order snapshot of [HTMLOptionElement] handles.

method.name: get_selected_options
method.description: Returns the selected options in tree order.

members.member: The name used for the form entry.
Whether submission requires a selection other than the placeholder.
The first selected option value. Assigning a matching value selects only that option. An unmatched assignment clears the selection.
Zero-based selected index. [code]-1[/code] means no selection.
Whether the list accepts multiple selections.
The requested visible row count. The default value is 0.
